categories.title: Entry and lifecycle
categories.summary: Create the application runtime, install the adapter, and release its observers.
categories.summaryZh: 创建应用级运行时、安装适配器，并释放它持有的观察器。

entries.name: createPling
entries.summary: Creates the application-level Pling instance and returns the adapter-specific runtime object.
entries.summaryZh: 创建应用级 Pling 实例，并返回对应适配器的运行时对象。

signatures.vue3:
createPling(options?: PlingOptions): PlingElement;
createPling(registry: Registry | undefined, options?: PlingOptions): PlingElement;
signatures.react:
createPling(options?: PlingOptions): PlingElement;
createPling(registry: Registry | undefined, options?: PlingOptions): PlingElement;

entries.returns: The adapter instance. Vue 3 and React return PlingElement; Vue 2.7 and Vanilla return VanillaPling.
entries.returnsZh: 适配器实例。Vue 3 与 React 返回 PlingElement；Vue 2.7 与原生 JS 返回 VanillaPling。
defaults: No declaration means no action; derive is off by default.
defaultsZh: 未声明的控件不会成为动作；derive 默认关闭。
聊天中还原敏感值默认开启。

entries.name: PlingProvider
entries.summary: Publishes a Pling instance to the React tree. Every React declaration hook reads from this provider.
entries.summaryZh: 把 Pling 实例放入 React 组件树。所有 React 声明 Hook 都从这里取实例。

entries.name: usePling
entries.summary: Reads the nearest Pling instance from the framework tree.
entries.summaryZh: 从当前框架组件树中读取最近的 Pling 实例。

entries.name: usePlingUi
entries.summary: Subscribes a React component to the shared locale, theme, CSS variables, and message snapshot.
entries.summaryZh: 让 React 组件订阅共享的语言、主题、CSS 变量与文案快照。

entries.name: pling.plugin
entries.summary: Installs Vue directives and the runtime injection key. React uses PlingProvider instead.
entries.summaryZh: 安装 Vue 指令与运行时注入键。React 使用 PlingProvider。

entries.name: PlingElement
entries.summary: The Vue 3 and React application runtime: registry, UI controller, page tracker, task routing, coverage, and cleanup. Vue 3 also owns the page guided-task catalog.
entries.summaryZh: Vue 3 与 React 的应用级运行时：注册表、UI 控制器、页面身份、任务路由、覆盖率与清理。Vue 3 还持有当前页面的引导任务目录。

entries.name: VanillaPling
entries.summary: The DOM-first runtime used by Vanilla JS and Vue 2.7. It exposes declarations, feedback, task routing, page identity, coverage, the dock, and the Surface gateway.
entries.summaryZh: 原生 JS 与 Vue 2.7 共用的 DOM 运行时，暴露声明、反馈、任务路由、页面身份、覆盖率、浮窗与 Surface 网关。

entries.name: pling.destroy
entries.summary: Stops observers, derived actions, scopes, presence, UI subscriptions, and mounted assistant surfaces.
entries.summaryZh: 停止观察器、派生动作、作用域、存在感、UI 订阅与已挂载的助手界面。

categories.title: Page declarations
categories.summary: Declare actions, records, regions, state, feedback, task entrances, and sensitive values.
categories.summaryZh: 声明动作、记录、区域、状态、页面反馈、任务入口与敏感值。

entries.name: Element action
entries.summary: Declares what a control does. The description is the model's only explanation; execution still goes through availability, approval, and expectations.
entries.summaryZh: 声明一个控件能做什么。说明是模型唯一的判断依据；执行仍经过可用性、确认与结果判据。

signatures.react: usePlingTool<T extends Element = HTMLElement>(options: PlingToolOptions): RefCallback<T>

entries.name: Function-level action
entries.summary: Registers a business operation that has no dedicated DOM control.
entries.summaryZh: 登记一个没有专属 DOM 控件的业务操作。

entries.name: Region
entries.summary: Declares a structural region and its reachability. Regions explain context; they are not permission boundaries.
entries.summaryZh: 声明页面的结构区域及其可达性。区域解释上下文，不是权限边界。

signatures.vue3: v-scope="string | { id; label?; description?; role?; parent? }"
signatures.react: usePlingScope<T extends Element = HTMLElement>(options: PlingScopeOptions): RefCallback<T>

entries.name: Record
entries.summary: Gives one row a stable identity and a bounded set of readable fields. Records are read-only.
entries.summaryZh: 为一行数据提供稳定身份与有界字段。记录是只读的。

signatures.react: usePlingRecord<T extends Element = HTMLElement>(value: RecordValue | null | undefined): RefCallback<T>
signatures.vanilla: pling.record(element: Element, value: RecordValue | null | undefined): () => void

entries.name: Read-only state
entries.summary: Exposes a derived view of current UI state. State has no setter; writes must be declared as actions.
entries.summaryZh: 暴露当前 UI 状态的只读视图。状态没有 setter；写入必须声明成动作。

signatures.vue3: useAgentState(key: string, source: StateSource, options?: AgentStateOptions | string): () => void
signatures.react: usePlingState(key: string, source: PlingStateSource, options?: PlingStateOptions | string): () => void
signatures.vue2: useAgentState(key: string, source: StateSource, options?: AgentStateOptions | string): () => void
signatures.vanilla: pling.state(key: string, source: StateSource, options?: StateOptions | string): () => void

entries.name: exposePlingState
entries.summary: Registers a read-only state view outside the React component tree. It returns an unregister function.
entries.summaryZh: 在 React 组件树之外登记只读状态视图，并返回注销函数。

signatures.react: exposePlingState(pling: Pick<PlingElement, "registry">, key: string, source: PlingStateSource, options?: PlingStateOptions | string): () => void

entries.name: Store state
entries.summary: Selects named fields from a Pinia or Vuex store. It never exposes the whole store.
entries.summaryZh: 从 Pinia 或 Vuex 中显式选择字段，不会把整个 store 暴露给模型。

signatures.vue3: useAgentStoreState<S extends object>(key: string, store: S, read: AgentStoreRead<S>, options?: AgentStateOptions | string): () => void
signatures.vue2: useAgentStoreState<S extends object>(key: string, store: S, read: AgentStoreRead<S>, options?: AgentStateOptions | string): () => void

entries.name: Page feedback
entries.summary: Publishes user-visible feedback or a short page-level explanation without turning it into an action.
entries.summaryZh: 发布用户可见的反馈或页面级说明，不把它变成动作。

signatures.vanilla: pling.declareFeedback(element: Element, value: FeedbackValue | readonly FeedbackValue[]): () => void

entries.name: Task entrance
entries.summary: Routes a human-authored instruction to the mounted assistant. It is not exposed to the model as an action.
entries.summaryZh: 把人写的任务交给已挂载的助手。它不会作为动作暴露给模型。

signatures.vue3:
v-task="string | TaskOptions"
pling.ask(prompt: string, options?: PlingAskOptions): Promise<void>
signatures.vanilla:
pling.declareTask(element: HTMLElement, value: string | TaskOptions): () => void
pling.ask(prompt: string, options?: PlingAskOptions): Promise<void>

entries.name: Guide target
entries.summary: Highlights a non-action target while a person completes a handoff step.
entries.summaryZh: 人工接力时高亮一个并非动作的目标元素。

signatures.react: usePlingGuideTarget<T extends Element = HTMLElement>(id: string): RefCallback<T>

entries.name: sensitive
entries.summary: Marks a value for outbound masking, tokenization, or a hint while keeping the field name visible.
entries.summaryZh: 标记一个值在出站时隐藏、遮罩、代号化或只给提示，同时保留字段名。

signatures.core: sensitive<T>(value: T, options?: SensitivityMode | SensitiveOptions): SensitiveValue<T>

categories.title: Shared option types
categories.summary: The option shapes referenced by declarations. Adapter aliases are listed where the name differs.
categories.summaryZh: 声明所引用的选项结构。适配器使用不同名称时，会同时列出别名。

entries.name: ToolOptions
entries.summary: The action declaration shape shared by every adapter.
entries.summaryZh: 所有适配器共享的动作声明结构。

entries.name: ScopeOptions
entries.summary: The region declaration shape. Vue 3 exposes the equivalent value as ScopeValue.
entries.summaryZh: 区域声明结构。Vue 3 以 ScopeValue 暴露等价类型。

entries.name: RecordValue
entries.summary: A row value or a full record declaration with explicit id, label, and fields.
entries.summaryZh: 一行数据，或带显式 id、label、fields 的完整记录声明。

entries.name: State options
entries.summary: Optional description for a read-only state view.
entries.summaryZh: 只读状态视图的可选说明。

entries.name: AgentSetup
entries.summary: Application-level runtime options: model overrides, hooks, gates, event handling, trace, and continuity.
entries.summaryZh: 应用级运行时选项：模型覆盖、钩子、闸门、事件、跟踪与连续性。

entries.name: Kind
entries.summary: The action risk level used by approval policy.
entries.summaryZh: 动作的风险等级，供确认策略使用。

signatures.core: type Kind = "read" | "write" | "danger"

entries.name: ParamDeclaration
entries.summary: Array shorthand or JSON Schema used to validate action arguments.
entries.summaryZh: 用于校验动作参数的数组简写或 JSON Schema。

signatures.core: type ParamDeclaration = readonly ToolParam[] | JsonSchema

entries.name: AgentToolOptions
entries.summary: The declaration shape for a function-level action: stable id, model-facing description, optional schema, availability, expectation, and implementation.
entries.summaryZh: 函数级动作的声明结构：稳定 id、面向模型的说明、可选参数协议、可用性、成功判据与实现。

entries.name: Expectation
entries.summary: A success condition checked after an action finishes.
entries.summaryZh: 动作结束后检查的成功条件。

entries.name: HandoffStep
entries.summary: One instruction shown to a person during human handoff.
entries.summaryZh: 人工接力时展示给用户的一条步骤说明。

entries.name: FlowStep
entries.summary: One step in a compound action. Flow steps are not a second execution channel.
entries.summaryZh: 复合动作中的一步。步骤不是第二条执行通道。

entries.name: RegionRole
entries.summary: The structural role of a region.
entries.summaryZh: 区域的结构角色。

signatures.core:
type RegionRole =
  | "page"
  | "header"
  | "nav"
  | "main"
  | "aside"
  | "section"
  | "form"
  | "dialog"
  | "toolbar"
  | "list"
  | "footer"

entries.name: PlingUiOptions
entries.summary: Locale, theme, message overrides, and class names for the shared assistant UI.
entries.summaryZh: 共享助手界面的语言、主题、文案覆盖与类名。

entries.name: ModelSettingsSetting
entries.summary: Controls whether the activity view exposes application-managed or user-supplied model settings.
entries.summaryZh: 控制运行视图是否展示应用托管或用户自带的模型设置。

categories.title: Agent runtime
categories.summary: Model configuration, sessions, approval and handoff, hooks, tracing, and shared runtime helpers.
categories.summaryZh: 模型配置、会话、确认与人工接力、钩子、跟踪，以及共享运行时辅助函数。

entries.name: AgentRuntimeOptions
entries.summary: The runtime contract behind AgentSetup: config, registry, model, events, hooks, gates, trace, and continuity.
entries.summaryZh: AgentSetup 背后的运行时契约：配置、注册表、模型、事件、钩子、闸门、跟踪与连续性。

entries.name: AgentConfigOverrides
entries.summary: A partial model configuration. Unspecified fields continue to come from environment variables and defaults.
entries.summaryZh: 部分模型配置。未指定的字段继续来自环境变量与默认值。

entries.name: HookRegistry
entries.summary: PreToolUse and PostToolUse hooks for application policy, redaction, and audit without adding a second executor.
entries.summaryZh: PreToolUse 与 PostToolUse 钩子，用于应用策略、脱敏与审计，不引入第二套执行器。

entries.name: SessionEvent
entries.summary: The single event stream consumed by chat, activity, audit, and evaluation views.
entries.summaryZh: 对话、运行记录、审计与评测视图共同消费的单一事件流。

entries.name: AgentTraceOptions
entries.summary: Bounds the number of model calls retained by the read-only inspector.
entries.summaryZh: 限制只读调试器保留的模型调用数量。

signatures.core: interface AgentTraceOptions { maxCalls?: number }

entries.name: waitFor
entries.summary: Waits for an asynchronous UI condition inside a run or expectation.
entries.summaryZh: 在 run 或结果判据中等待异步 UI 条件成立。

signatures.core: waitFor(check: () => boolean | Promise<boolean>, options?: WaitForOptions): Promise<boolean>

entries.name: describeFlow
entries.summary: Produces a model-readable description of a compound action without executing it.
entries.summaryZh: 生成复合动作的模型可读说明，不执行动作。

signatures.core: describeFlow(report: FlowReport): string

categories.title: Assistant surfaces
categories.summary: Mounted conversation and inspection surfaces. They render the shared runtime; they do not create a second agent.
categories.summaryZh: 已挂载的对话与检查界面。它们渲染共享运行时，不创建第二个 Agent。

entries.name: AgentDock
entries.summary: Floating or sidebar assistant surface. Owns placement, task registration, open state, and the activity view.
entries.summaryZh: 浮动或侧边栏助手界面，负责位置、任务登记、展开状态与运行视图。

entries.name: AgentInline
entries.summary: Embeds the conversation in a business column instead of a floating surface.
entries.summaryZh: 把对话嵌入业务列，而不是使用浮动界面。

entries.name: AgentChat
entries.summary: Renders a conversation and confirmation state without owning placement or the session.
entries.summaryZh: 渲染对话与确认状态，不负责位置或会话所有权。

entries.name: AgentPanel
entries.summary: Development-only snapshot view of what the agent can currently see.
entries.summaryZh: 开发期只读快照视图，用来查看 Agent 当前能看到什么。

entries.name: AgentDebug
entries.summary: React read-only inspector for the runtime already driving a conversation.
entries.summaryZh: React 只读调试器，检查当前对话实际使用的运行时。

entries.name: VanillaDock
entries.summary: The DOM dock controller returned by pling.dock(): element, runtime, open, close, toggle, isOpen, destroy.
entries.summaryZh: pling.dock() 返回的 DOM 浮窗控制器：element、runtime、open、close、toggle、isOpen、destroy。

entries.name: createPlingUi
entries.summary: Creates the shared locale, theme, and message controller behind a built-in assistant surface.
entries.summaryZh: 创建内置助手界面背后的共享语言、主题与文案控制器。

categories.title: External Agent Surface
categories.summary: Vue wrappers for exposing declared capabilities through a Surface gateway. They manage credentials and transport; the capability allowlist and human approval stay in the application.
categories.summaryZh: 通过 Surface 网关开放已声明能力的 Vue 封装。它们管理凭证与传输；能力 allowlist 与真人审批仍归应用所有。

entries.name: useSurfaceGateway
entries.summary: Creates and owns the page session, WebSocket, Surface bridge, pairing, claim, and revocation lifecycle for one Vue component scope.
entries.summaryZh: 为一个 Vue 组件作用域创建并托管页面会话、WebSocket、Surface 桥接、配对、申领与撤销的生命周期。

entries.name: SurfaceAccessPanel
entries.summary: Optional Vue panel for connection state, pairing, a copyable Agent token, the current scope, and revocation. It renders a controller; it does not create capabilities.
entries.summaryZh: 可选的 Vue 面板：展示连接状态、配对、可复制的 Agent token、当前 scope 与撤销操作。它只渲染控制器，不创建能力。

entries.name: SurfaceTask
entries.summary: A business task exposed to external agents. It explains which capabilities belong together, but it is not an authorization grant.
entries.summaryZh: 向外部 Agent 说明的业务任务。它解释哪些能力配合完成一件事，但不是授权。

entries.name: SurfaceTaskField
entries.summary: A descriptive field in a Surface task. Agents still send values only through the existing capability input schema.
entries.summaryZh: Surface 任务中的描述性字段。Agent 仍只能通过现有能力的输入协议传值。

entries.name: SurfaceTaskStep
entries.summary: A descriptive step that names an existing capability. It never adds a second execution path.
entries.summaryZh: 描述性步骤，只引用已有能力，不增加第二套执行路径。

entries.name: pling.surfaceGateway
entries.summary: Creates the plain-DOM Surface gateway controller for an explicit capability allowlist. It shares the page registry and never infers capabilities from the DOM.
entries.summaryZh: 为显式能力 allowlist 创建原生 DOM Surface 网关控制器。它复用页面注册表，绝不从 DOM 推断能力。

entries.name: createSurfaceAccessPanel
entries.summary: Mounts the plain-DOM counterpart of the Vue access panel: connection state, pairing, a copyable Agent token, the active scope, and revocation.
entries.summaryZh: 挂载 Vue 访问面板的原生 DOM 对应物：连接状态、配对、可复制的 Agent token、当前 scope 与撤销。

categories.title: Page identity and continuity
categories.summary: Read page identity, share a runtime across frames, and inspect declared coverage.
categories.summaryZh: 读取页面身份、在同源框架间共享运行时，并检查声明覆盖率。

entries.name: PageOptions
entries.summary: Controls automatic page identity, router integration, query allowlisting, hash handling, and title overrides.
entries.summaryZh: 控制自动页面身份、路由集成、query 白名单、hash 处理与标题覆盖。

entries.name: PlingPage
entries.summary: A page-level runtime shared by multiple framework islands or same-origin frames.
entries.summaryZh: 由多个框架岛或同源 iframe 共享的页面级运行时。

entries.name: createPlingPage
entries.summary: Creates the shared registry, scopes, and page identity that adapters can join with shared.
entries.summaryZh: 创建共享注册表、作用域与页面身份，适配器可通过 shared 加入。

signatures.core: createPlingPage(options?: PlingPageOptions): PlingPage

entries.name: sharePlingPageWithFrame
entries.summary: Shares a page runtime with a same-origin iframe and returns a cleanup function.
entries.summaryZh: 把页面运行时共享给同源 iframe，并返回清理函数。

signatures.core: sharePlingPageWithFrame(frame: HTMLIFrameElement, page: PlingPage): () => void

entries.name: plingPageFromParent
entries.summary: Reads a shared page runtime from the parent window when the current document is an embedded frame.
entries.summaryZh: 当前文档是嵌入 frame 时，从父窗口读取共享页面运行时。

signatures.core: plingPageFromParent(win?: Window): PlingPage | undefined

entries.name: waitForPlingPageFromParent
entries.summary: Waits for a parent frame to publish its page runtime.
entries.summaryZh: 等待父 frame 发布页面运行时。

signatures.core: waitForPlingPageFromParent(options?: WaitForFramePageOptions): Promise<PlingPage>

entries.name: inspectCoverage
entries.summary: Scans the mounted page for interactive controls that have no declaration. It reports; it never registers an action.
entries.summaryZh: 扫描已挂载页面中尚未声明的交互控件。它只报告，不注册动作。

signatures.core: inspectCoverage(root: Element | null): CoverageReport

categories.title: Guided tasks
categories.summary: Goals and advanced tasks. A goal declares an outcome, boundaries and success criteria; fields and execution stay on the real page. Advanced tasks add field schemas, lookups and fixed steps only when page actions cannot express the requirement.
categories.summaryZh: 目标与进阶任务。目标只声明结果、边界和成功条件，字段与执行都留在真实页面。只有页面动作无法表达需求时，进阶任务才增加字段 schema、查找和固定步骤。

entries.name: createTaskController
entries.summary: Creates a framework-independent task controller. The host supplies the only execution bridge through invoke.
entries.summaryZh: 创建框架无关的任务控制器。宿主通过 `invoke` 提供唯一的执行桥。

signatures.core: createTaskController(options: TaskControllerOptions): TaskController

entries.name: createTaskCatalog
entries.summary: Creates the page's guided-task catalog. It selects tasks by route and active scope, activates one guide at a time, and binds the narrow pling_start_task action to the current registry.
entries.summaryZh: 创建当前页面的引导任务目录。它按路由与活跃作用域筛选任务，同一时刻激活一个引导，并把窄动作 `pling_start_task` 绑定到当前注册表。

signatures.core: createTaskCatalog(options?: TaskCatalogOptions): TaskCatalog

entries.name: TaskCatalog
entries.summary: The current page's task catalog: register goals or advanced tasks, query what is available now, activate at most one guide, complete a goal, forward guide commands, and notify renderers.
entries.summaryZh: 当前页面的任务目录：登记目标或进阶任务、查询此刻可用的任务、至多激活一个引导、完成目标、转发引导命令，并通知渲染方。

entries.name: TaskGoalInput
entries.summary: The minimal task declaration: id, title, outcome, boundaries, success criteria, examples and optional route/scope continuity. It has no fields, steps, controller or business callbacks.
entries.summaryZh: 最小任务声明：id、标题、结果、边界、成功条件、示例，以及可选的路由/作用域连续性。它没有字段、步骤、控制器或业务回调。

entries.name: GuidedTaskRegistration
entries.summary: One catalog entry: an executable definition, an optional guide, the route and scopes that make it available, whether an explicit run survives context changes, live state, and lifecycle hooks.
entries.summaryZh: 任务目录中的一项登记：可执行定义、可选引导、决定可用性的路由与作用域、显式运行是否跨上下文保留、实时状态，以及生命周期钩子。

entries.name: GuidedTaskActivationOptions
entries.summary: Optional values already supplied before activation. Unknown fields are rejected before the active state changes.
entries.summaryZh: 激活前已经拿到的字段值。未知字段会在 active 状态改变前被拒绝。

entries.name: ActiveGuidedTask
entries.summary: The one task currently presented to the user: definition, optional guide, optional controller, live render state, and whether the page or the model opened it.
entries.summaryZh: 当前展示给用户的唯一任务：定义、可选引导、可选控制器、实时渲染状态，以及它由页面还是模型开启。

entries.name: TaskGuideDefinition
entries.summary: The human-facing half of a task: welcome copy, ordered steps, read-only summaries, button commands, completion copy, and handoff points.
entries.summaryZh: 任务面向人的一半：欢迎文案、有序步骤、只读摘要、按钮命令、完成文案与人工接力点。

entries.name: TaskGuideField
entries.summary: One node in the compact field rail. It reports which values are filled, suggested, or explicitly skipped, and emits `focus-<field>` unless the business supplies another command.
entries.summaryZh: 紧凑字段轨道中的一个节点。它报告哪些值已填入、已有建议或被明确跳过；默认发出 `focus-<field>`，业务也可以覆盖命令。

entries.name: TaskGuideStep
entries.summary: One guided step. It can show read-only rows, point a person at the page, or emit a business-owned command without gaining a second execution path.
entries.summaryZh: 一个引导步骤。它可以显示只读摘要、引导用户在页面上操作，或发出业务自有命令，但不会获得第二套执行路径。

entries.name: TaskGuideAction
entries.summary: A guide button label plus a business-owned command name. The renderer forwards the command and never guesses what it means.
entries.summaryZh: 引导按钮的文案与业务自有命令名。渲染器只转发命令，不猜测它的含义。

entries.name: TaskGuideRow
entries.summary: One read-only summary row. It can distinguish an existing page value from a suggestion that has not been written yet, and can carry a row-level business command.
entries.summaryZh: 一行只读摘要。它可以区分页面当前值与尚未写入的建议值，并可携带行级业务命令。

entries.name: TaskGuideDone
entries.summary: The completion state shown after the task succeeds, including a final summary and optional follow-up commands.
entries.summaryZh: 任务成功后的完成状态，包括最终摘要与可选的后续命令。

entries.name: TaskGuideCommand
entries.summary: A command emitted by the guide, with the step and completion context the page needs to decide what to do next.
entries.summaryZh: 引导发出的命令，并带上页面决定下一步所需的步骤与完成上下文。

entries.name: TaskGuideState
entries.summary: Live render state returned by a registration: the task snapshot, current step, busy state, error, and completion flag.
entries.summaryZh: 登记项返回的实时渲染状态：任务快照、当前步骤、忙碌状态、错误与完成标记。

entries.name: GuidedTaskView
entries.summary: A compact, read-only task description for model context and task lists. It is derived from the definition and optional guide.
entries.summaryZh: 供模型上下文与任务列表使用的紧凑只读任务说明，由定义与可选引导派生。

entries.name: TaskDefinition
entries.summary: A guided task as a goal, constraints, success criteria, working-memory fields, and optional deterministic steps or an agent prompt.
entries.summaryZh: 一个引导任务：目标、约束、成功判据、工作记忆字段，以及可选的确定性步骤或 Agent 提示词。

entries.name: TaskBinding
entries.summary: Page facts supplied when a task starts. They are separate from user-editable values so a record id never becomes a form field.
entries.summaryZh: 任务启动时由页面提供的上下文。它与用户可编辑的字段分开，避免记录 id 意外变成表单字段。

entries.name: TaskRecordBinding
entries.summary: The record already selected by the page, such as a lesson row or a detail page. The task uses its id but does not ask the user to type it.
entries.summaryZh: 页面已经选中的记录，例如课表的一行或详情页。任务直接使用它的 id，不再要求用户输入。

entries.name: TaskField
entries.summary: One item in task working memory: a decision the user may need to make, a recommendation, or a page-only value the agent cannot write.
entries.summaryZh: 任务工作记忆中的一项：可能需要用户做出的决定、推荐值，或 Agent 不可写的页面专属值。

entries.name: TaskLookup
entries.summary: The search implementation shared by the task UI and the automatically registered search action.
entries.summaryZh: 任务界面与自动注册的搜索动作共用的搜索实现。

signatures.core: type TaskLookup = (query: string, context: TaskLookupContext) => Promise<readonly TaskChoice[]> | readonly TaskChoice[]

entries.name: TaskLookupContext
entries.summary: Optional cancellation signal for an asynchronous lookup.
entries.summaryZh: 异步查找可使用的取消信号。

entries.name: TaskStep
entries.summary: One existing action call in a deterministic task. Arguments can be static, come from collected values, or use the record selected before the task opened.
entries.summaryZh: 确定性任务中的一次已有动作调用。参数可以是静态值、来自已填字段，或使用打开任务前选中的页面记录。

entries.name: TaskStepSnapshot
entries.summary: One rendered step: its action, status, optional handoff marker, failure, and result.
entries.summaryZh: 一个渲染步骤：动作、状态、可选的人工接力标记、失败与结果。

entries.name: TaskRunStatus
entries.summary: The run lifecycle. planned, running, and verifying separate an approved plan, active work, and the check after an action returns.
entries.summaryZh: 任务运行的生命周期。`planned`、`running` 与 `verifying` 分别表示已确定的计划、正在执行，以及动作返回后的检查。

signatures.core: type TaskRunStatus = "collecting" | "ready" | "planned" | "running" | "waiting" | "verifying" | "done" | "failed" | "cancelled"

entries.name: TaskWaitingFor
entries.summary: Why a run is waiting: a task-level confirmation, or a step the user must complete in person.
entries.summaryZh: 运行在等待什么：任务级确认，或必须由用户亲自完成的步骤。

signatures.core: type TaskWaitingFor = "confirmation" | "handoff"

entries.name: TaskRunContext
entries.summary: Context passed to invoke and to the optional progress reporter. report() can mark a long step as verifying or waiting for handoff.
entries.summaryZh: 传给 `invoke` 与可选进度上报器的上下文。`report()` 可把长步骤标记为核对中或等待人工接力。

entries.name: TaskRunSnapshot
entries.summary: The complete render state of one task run: values, bound page record, status, step progress, prompt, confirmation, error, and timestamps.
entries.summaryZh: 一次任务运行的完整渲染状态：字段值、绑定的页面记录、状态、步骤进度、提示词、确认、错误与时间戳。

entries.name: TaskController
entries.summary: Registers definitions and owns one active run. Start another task to cancel the previous run.
entries.summaryZh: 注册任务定义并持有一个活动运行。启动另一个任务会取消前一个运行。

entries.name: TaskChoice
entries.summary: A selectable reference. The value is what the action needs; the label and description are what the user sees.
entries.summaryZh: 一个可选项。`value` 是动作真正需要的引用，`label` 与 `description` 是用户看到的内容。

entries.name: QuickTask
entries.summary: The structured form of a recommended task button; a plain string remains the one-line shorthand.
entries.summaryZh: 推荐任务按钮的结构化写法；普通字符串仍是单行简写。

entries.name: QuickTaskItem
entries.summary: A quick-task entry accepted by assistant surfaces: either a string prompt or a structured QuickTask.
entries.summaryZh: 助手入口接受的快捷任务项：字符串提示词，或结构化的 `QuickTask`。

signatures.core: type QuickTaskItem = string | QuickTask

entries.name: TaskInvoke
entries.summary: The host execution bridge. It should call the existing executor, Surface, or business service and may return void, { ok }, or ExecResult.
entries.summaryZh: 宿主执行桥。它应调用现有执行器、Surface 或业务服务，可返回 `void`、`{ ok }` 或 `ExecResult`。

signatures.core: type TaskInvoke = (action: string, args: Record<string, unknown>, context: TaskRunContext) => unknown | Promise<unknown>

entries.name: registerTaskLookupActions
entries.summary: Registers every lookup field as a narrow read action so the model can search by a human name instead of inventing ids. The UI and model call the same lookup.
entries.summaryZh: 把每个 lookup 字段注册成窄范围只读动作，让模型按人可读的名称搜索，而不是猜 id。界面与模型调用同一份查找实现。

signatures.vanilla: registerTaskLookupActions(host: Pick<VanillaHost, "registry" | "warn">, definitions: readonly TaskDefinition[], options?: TaskLookupActionOptions): () => void

entries.name: TaskLookupActionOptions
entries.summary: Result limit, action-id override, description override, and warning hook for generated lookup actions.
entries.summaryZh: 生成搜索动作时的结果上限、动作 id 覆盖、描述覆盖与告警钩子。

entries.name: TaskLookupResult
entries.summary: The normalized result of a lookup action: the query, the minimum length when it was too short, and at most maxResults choices.
entries.summaryZh: 查找动作的规范化结果：查询、命中最小长度限制时的要求，以及最多 `maxResults` 个候选。

entries.name: createTaskPanel
entries.summary: Renders a task controller as a standalone framework-independent DOM workspace. Agent-mode prompts are handed back through onPrompt or a DOM event.
entries.summaryZh: 把任务控制器渲染成独立的框架无关 DOM 工作区。Agent 模式生成的提示词通过 `onPrompt` 或 DOM 事件交还宿主。

entries.name: createTaskCard
entries.summary: Renders a task controller as a compact DOM card for the assistant transcript. It shares the same run controller as createTaskPanel.
entries.summaryZh: 把任务控制器渲染成助手消息流里的紧凑 DOM 任务卡，与 `createTaskPanel` 共用同一份运行控制器。

entries.name: createTaskGuide
entries.summary: Creates the reference DOM renderer for a TaskGuideDefinition. It renders steps, read-only summaries, handoff copy, and command buttons; it never executes a business action itself.
entries.summaryZh: 为 `TaskGuideDefinition` 创建参考 DOM 渲染器。它渲染步骤、只读摘要、人工接力说明与命令按钮，自身不执行任何业务动作。

entries.name: GuidedTaskGuide
entries.summary: The mounted guide, with methods to update the snapshot, step, busy state, error, completion state, and to destroy its DOM.
entries.summaryZh: 已挂载的引导，提供更新快照、步骤、忙碌状态、错误、完成状态以及销毁 DOM 的方法。

entries.name: AgentTaskGuide
entries.summary: Vue lifecycle shell around the shared DOM task guide. Built-in assistant surfaces render it automatically; use it directly only when replacing the default task presentation.
entries.summaryZh: 共享 DOM 任务引导的 Vue 生命周期外壳。内置助手界面会自动渲染它；只有替换默认任务展示时才需要直接使用。

entries.name: AgentTaskCard
entries.summary: Vue and React shell around the shared DOM task card for products that deliberately replace the default guide. Built-in assistant surfaces now render the active TaskGuideDefinition automatically.
entries.summaryZh: 共享 DOM 任务卡的 Vue 与 React 外壳，供有意替换默认引导的产品使用。内置助手界面现在会自动渲染 active 的 `TaskGuideDefinition`。

entries.name: createGuideActions
entries.summary: Renders the compact guided-task action row used by every adapter. A short verb carries the action; a long recommendation becomes a one-line ellipsised preview with the full value in title and aria-label.
entries.summaryZh: 渲染所有适配器共用的紧凑引导任务操作行。按钮只保留短动作；长推荐变成单行省略预览，完整值保留在 `title` 与 `aria-label` 中。

signatures.core: createGuideActions(options: GuideActionsOptions): GuideActions

entries.name: AgentGuideActions
entries.summary: Vue and React lifecycle shell around the shared compact action row. The host supplies items and handles commands; the renderer never writes a field.
entries.summaryZh: 共享紧凑操作行的 Vue 与 React 生命周期外壳。宿主提供选项并处理命令；渲染器从不写入字段。

signatures.vue3:
<AgentGuideActions
  :items="items"
  hint="保存前再核对一次"
  aria-label="任务操作"
  @command="handleCommand"
/>
signatures.react:
<AgentGuideActions
  items={items}
  hint="Check once before saving"
  ariaLabel="Task actions"
  onCommand={handleCommand}
/>

entries.name: GuideActionItem
entries.summary: One action in the compact row: a short label, an opaque business command, an optional kind, and the long recommendation kept as a preview rather than a label.
entries.summaryZh: 紧凑操作行中的一项：短标签、业务自定义命令、可选类型，以及作为预览而不是标签的长推荐。

entries.name: AgentTaskCardHandle
entries.summary: React imperative handle exposed by AgentTaskCard: open a task with a page binding, switch the catalog, refresh, or close. Vue uses the component ref with the same methods.
entries.summaryZh: React `AgentTaskCard` 暴露的命令式句柄：带页面绑定打开任务、切换任务目录、刷新或关闭。Vue 通过组件 ref 使用同名方法。

entries.name: GuidedTaskPanelOptions
entries.summary: Locale, presentation variant, catalog visibility, task entry, prompt handoff, and completion callbacks for the reference DOM renderer.
entries.summaryZh: 参考 DOM 渲染器的语言、外观形态、目录可见性、初始任务、提示词回传与完成回调。

entries.name: GuidedTaskPanel
entries.summary: The mounted DOM renderer and its open, close, refresh, catalog, and destroy lifecycle.
entries.summaryZh: 已挂载的 DOM 渲染器，以及打开、关闭、刷新、目录切换与销毁生命周期。

categories.title: Testing and execution helpers
categories.summary: Deterministic model replay, evaluation, page-context rendering, and the core executor used by tests, external agents, and advanced hosts.
categories.summaryZh: 用于测试、外部 Agent 与高级宿主的确定性模型回放、评测、页面上下文渲染与核心执行器。

entries.name: createReplayLlm
entries.summary: Creates a deterministic model from scripted turns. It exercises the real loop, tool dispatch, approvals, and failure path without a network call.
entries.summaryZh: 用预先写好的轮次创建确定性模型。它走真实的循环、工具分发、确认与失败路径，但不需要网络。

signatures.core: createReplayLlm(turns: readonly ReplayTurn[]): ReplayLlm

entries.name: EvalCase
entries.summary: One evaluation case: input, expected and forbidden actions, an optional tool-error budget, and a business-state check.
entries.summaryZh: 一条评测用例：输入、期望与禁止调用的动作、可选工具错误预算，以及业务状态检查。

entries.name: runEvaluation
entries.summary: Runs a set of EvalCase entries through one host callback, resets state between cases, and returns a pass/fail report.
entries.summaryZh: 通过同一个宿主回调运行一组 EvalCase，在用例之间重置状态，并返回通过/失败报告。

signatures.core: runEvaluation(options: EvaluateOptions): Promise<EvalReport>

entries.name: createAgentLoop
entries.summary: Creates the lower-level conversation loop for tests and custom hosts. Most applications should use AgentSetup or createAgentRuntime instead.
entries.summaryZh: 为测试与自定义宿主创建较低层的对话循环。大多数应用应使用 AgentSetup 或 createAgentRuntime。

signatures.core: createAgentLoop(options: LoopOptions): AgentLoop

entries.name: defaultSettle
entries.summary: Waits for DOM updates, one browser frame, and a short idle window before the next page snapshot is read.
entries.summaryZh: 在读取下一份页面快照前，等待 DOM 更新、一个浏览器帧与短暂的静默窗口。

signatures.core: defaultSettle(): Promise<void>

entries.name: renderPageContext
entries.summary: Renders the bounded page context sent to the model: regions, actions, records, state, feedback, and page identity.
entries.summaryZh: 渲染发给模型的有界页面上下文：区域、动作、记录、状态、反馈与页面身份。

signatures.core: renderPageContext(snapshot: Snapshot, options?: ContextOptions): string

entries.name: createExecutor
entries.summary: Creates the shared executor used by the in-page agent and external Surface hosts. It is the only path that applies policy, availability, execution, and success checks.
entries.summaryZh: 创建页面内 Agent 与外部 Surface 宿主共用的执行器。只有这条路径会统一应用权限、可用性、执行与成功判据。

signatures.core: createExecutor(options: ExecutorOptions): Executor

entries.name: createPolicy
entries.summary: Creates a confirmation policy. With no confirmation channel it fails closed and denies actions that require approval.
entries.summaryZh: 创建确认策略。没有确认通道时按 fail-closed 处理，拒绝需要批准的动作。

signatures.core: createPolicy(confirm?: Confirm | null): Policy

categories.title: Diagnostics and errors
categories.summary: Stable error codes and localized rendering helpers. Codes remain authoritative across locales.
categories.summaryZh: 稳定错误码与本地化渲染辅助函数。跨语言时以错误码为准。

entries.name: describePlingError
entries.summary: Renders a Pling error through the shared message catalog while preserving the machine-readable code.
entries.summaryZh: 通过共享文案目录渲染 Pling 错误，同时保留机器可读错误码。

signatures.core: describePlingError(error: PlingErrorText, t: PlingTranslator): string

entries.name: describePlingDiagnostic
entries.summary: Renders a structured configuration diagnostic, including missing model fields and invalid limits.
entries.summaryZh: 渲染结构化配置诊断，包括缺失的模型字段与无效限额。

signatures.core: describePlingDiagnostic(diagnostic: PlingDiagnosticText, t: PlingTranslator): string

entries.name: resolveAgentConfig
entries.summary: Merges defaults, environment variables, and explicit overrides into the final model configuration.
entries.summaryZh: 合并默认值、环境变量与显式覆盖，得到最终模型配置。

signatures.core: resolveAgentConfig(options?: { env?; config? }): AgentConfig
